page_title: FRE 3-1 STU | Freiburg v Stuttgart 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
88' Anrie Chase (VfB Stuttgart) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.

87' Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart win a corner kick.
86' The total number of attempts is 14:6.
82' Here comes a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo is given a rest as he is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) comes onto the pitch so that Lukas Kubler can be given a rest.
81' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Chris Fuhrich.
80' The referee awards a corner and Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) goes over to take it.
79' A pass into the penalty area from Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) is intercepted by the defence.
75' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
73' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) replaces Maximilian Eggestein.
72' That's the end of the game for Ritsu Doan, who is replaced by Roland Sallai (Freiburg).
70' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
65' Pascal Stenzel will be replaced by Anrie Chase (VfB Stuttgart).
65' The substitution is prepared. Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Atakan Karazor.
65' Here is a change. Deniz Undav is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart).
64' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Welz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Holer (Freiburg) replaces Merlin Rohl.

61' 3 - 1 Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Vincenzo Grifo. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 3:1.
61' The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.
61' Wow, what an escape. Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
58' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
58' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Stuttgart.
57' It is time for a substitution. Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is on for Frans Kratzig.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Welz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' 2 - 1 Goal! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:1.
54' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Alexander Nubel easily makes the save.
53' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes.
51' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement.
47' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Freiburg are ruled offside.
41' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Welz had an easy-decision to make.

40' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Florian Muller!
34' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Alexander Nubel is alert and denies him.
33' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) strikes the ball from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His shot only goes narrowly wide of the left post.
30' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

30' A terrific piece of skill by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
28' The opposition can't get near Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.

26' 1 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg). He perfectly collected a pass from Junior Adamu and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
23' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
20' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
18' Freiburg are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
17' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
15' Freiburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
12' A lofted cross from Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Corner kick. Freiburg will have an opportunity.
11' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 31:69.
10' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
10' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexander Nubel intercepts the ball.
9' Tobias Welz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart).
9' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexander Nubel, who smothers the ball.
6' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Flag goes up against Junior Adamu (Freiburg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

2' 0 - 1 What a GOAL that is! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) showed great determination to get to the ball inside the box and acrobatically launched himself into the air and produced a scissor kick of the highest quality to leave Florian Muller helpless. He makes it 0:1.
2' A quickly taken corner by Stuttgart.
1' Frans Kratzig (VfB Stuttgart) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Stuttgart will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Tobias Welz.
